selection.score: mean annual return across 10 training cases - 0.5 * worst max drawdown - 0.25 * standard deviation of returns

limitations: Spot only, no leverage, no short selling; this is not a search across all possible strategies
Current instrument rules approximate past rules; currency conversion is fixed and excludes IDR FX changes and taxes
Training/validation fills use 1h OHLC; selected configurations get full 1m confirmation and increased-cost stress test
Annual runs cold-start indicators within each period; idle warmup and risk-triggered halts count in annual return
2025-2026 confirmation year was inspected previously; this is not a pristine holdout or proof of future profit
Five current large coins were selected with hindsight; survivorship/universe selection bias remains
216 variants create multiple-testing risk; all results and failures are retained, not just target hits
Aggressive profiles can lose substantial capital; a high historical return alone does not pass live approval
Final ranking is descriptive; configurations are frozen before validation and no automatic retuning occurs
Conservative terminal equity deducts estimated sale costs on remaining inventory; drawdown is the original intraperiod engine metric
One documented missing hourly bar at 2023-03-24 13:00 UTC is retained as a non-trading halt; no prices or fills fabricated. All other gaps fail validation.

sources.reason: Historical crypto time-series momentum motivates momentum and trend hypotheses, not a promised return.
Trend-following hypothesis; evidence across other markets is not validation of these crypto implementations.
Multiple testing and backtest overfitting motivate fixed selection and separate periods.
Official public spot candle archives with SHA256 checksums.
Official Binance notice of spot trading resumption after the 2023-03-24 halt.

data_halt_policy.policy: Retain absent hourly candle; no synthetic prices or executable bars; higher candles group by UTC clock; all other unexplained gaps fail.

amendments.reason: Handle documented Binance spot halt; zero backtests had started. Signal/risk/cost/selection definitions unchanged.
